name: Ca kho boi U Minh
summary: Cá khô bổi U Minh is dried sặc rằn from Trần Văn Thời. The fish grows slowly here, and the dried flesh is firm and fragrant.
origin: U Minh, in Trần Văn Thời. It is listed as a collective trademark on 24 October 2020 and on 23 December 2022.
howToEat: Carry it home as dried fish.
seoTitle: Ca kho boi U Minh — dried fish from Tran Van Thoi
seoDescription: Cá khô bổi U Minh is dried sặc rằn from Trần Văn Thời, with firm, fragrant flesh. A collective trademark to carry home.
